description:
Pessoa Executiva Comercial - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago

No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Trazer novos clientes para o canal, com perfil Grandes Contas.
  • Atuar no funil inteiro de vendas, desde prospecção, qualificação e negociação.
  • Acompanhar e analisar relatórios de atividades, assim como a eficiência do canal considerando dois KPIS, Volume Total de Pagamentos e Receitas.
  • Garantir o desenvolvimento do canal, participando ativamente na estruturação da metodologia, processos e, até mesmo, produto. Trazendo inputs para áreas responsáveis, representando os clientes e acelerando as melhorias.
  • Acompanhamento e compartilhamento das ações das concorrências, através de potenciais clientes, mercado e entorno competitivo diretos e indiretos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa.
  • Experiência em canais de vendas com foco em aquisição e formação de carteira de clientes.
  • Desejável conhecimentos em Adquirência.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

Customer Success Manager - Delphix (LATAM)

Perforce is a community of collaborative experts, problem solvers, and possibility seekers who believe work should be both challenging and fun. We are proud to inspire creativity, foster belonging, support collaboration, and encourage wellness. At Perforce, you’ll work with and learn from some of the best and brightest in business. Before you know it, you’ll be in the middle of a rewarding career at a company headed in one direction: upward.

With a global footprint spanning more than 80 countries and including over 75% of the Fortune 100, Perforce Software, Inc. is trusted by the world’s leading brands to deliver solutions for the toughest challenges. The best run DevOps teams in the world choose Perforce.

Position Summary:
The Delphix Customer Success Director, for the Delphix Customer Success Team at Perforce is searching for a Customer Success Manager to join the team. Able to tackle more complicated jobs and provide assistance where needed. Develop customer account plans that ensure alignment of our engagement to customer expectations and strategic business goals. Can handle a wide variety of problems and issues that come their way.

Responsibilities:

  • Establish and maintain relationships with key decision makers within assigned accounts.
  • Orchestrate relationships with assigned clients, which will include: defining value, increasing adoption and securing retention.
  • Ensure client reference ability to support the Sales organization in expansions and closing processes.
  • Facilitate executive-level engagements such as value assessment and realization, product strategy and EBRs.
  • Measure and monitor customer’s achievement of critical and key performance indicators, reporting both internally and externally.
  • Identify and manage escalations for successful resolution by driving internal and external team action items.
  • Develop strategic account plans for 100% consumption and areas of growth based on customer’s short, mid and long-term goals.
  • Know the market and maintain a good knowledge of all key competitors. Identify new use cases and new organizational contacts to expand on our customer’s realized value and organization success.
  • Be responsible for renewal, health and risk forecasting and reporting on your client portfolio.
  • May be required to support additional products/brands as needed.
Requirements:
  • Experience negotiating and closing customer contracts (renewals & expansion).
  • 5+ years history of success as a customer success manager, consultant, pre-sales, account management, technical account management or equivalent.
  • Experience working with partners.
  • Track record of guiding technical conversations and persuading others to take action based on requirements.
  • Experience in Software and ideally in DevOps, Test Data Management, Agile, CI/CD and/or Masking.
  • Must work within a team environment with sales, field services and delivery teams.
  • Knowledge of customer success tools such as Gainsight and efficient in creating PowerPoint presentations, Excel and ROIs.
  • At a minimum, must speak Portuguese, Spanish and English.
  • Must be able to travel at times.

If you are passionate about the technology that impacts our day-to-day lives and want to work with talented and dedicated people across the globe, apply today!

title: Advogado(a) Tributário Pleno
description:
Overview

Somos PepsiCo

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER, TODDY, TODDYNHO, ELMA CHIPS, RUFFLES, DORITOS, EQLIBRI, GATORADE, KERO COCO, H2OH!, PEPSI e muitas outras.

Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

Responsibilities

A oportunidade

Advogado Pleno para atuar no Departamento Tributário. O profissional será responsável, basicamente, pelo atendimento às fiscalizações e pelo acompanhamento de processos administrativos e judiciais.

O seu impacto

  • Atuar no atendimento às fiscalizações tributárias, analisando as apurações e demais documentações fiscais, fornecendo suporte técnico e jurídico.
  • Acompanhar processos administrativos e judiciais relacionados a questões tributárias.
  • Elaborar defesas e recursos em processos tributários.
  • Realizar análise de risco e propor estratégias jurídicas para a resolução de conflitos tributários.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre a legislação tributária e suas alterações.
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes internos e acompanhar solicitações de autoridades fiscais.
  • Preparar relatórios internos e pareceres jurídicos.

Qualifications

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Graduação em Direito.
  • Registro na OAB ativo.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos na área tributária.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado da legislação tributária brasileira.
  • Habilidade de trabalhar com diversas demandas simultâneas e cumprir prazos.
  • Organização e diligência na administração de tempo.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica e resolução de problemas.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.
  • Conhecimento em pacote Office: Excel, Word e Power Point esperado.
  • Power BI e Power Automate desejável.

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbrio para a sua saúde física, mental e emocional.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.

Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

title: Especialista de IC Analog Designer Jr
description:
Estamos em busca de um projetista de circuitos integrados experiente em layout analógico para apoiar o desenvolvimento de ASICs em projetos de alta complexidade. O profissional atuará em conjunto com a equipes de design analógico e também fazendo interface com a implementação física digital, sendo responsável por garantir a qualidade física e elétrica dos blocos críticos do projeto.
Responsabilidades:
- Planejar e executar o layout físico de circuitos analógicos e de sinal misto, com foco em matching, simetria, roteamento crítico e minimização de ruídos/parasitas.
- Implementar layouts de blocos como amplificadores operacionais, conversores A/D e D/A, PLLs, reguladores e referências de tensão/corrente, entre outros.
- Identificar a necessidade e aplicar técnicas avançadas de layout como common-centroid, interdigitação, shielding, deep n-well e guard rings.
- Interagir com a equipe de design esquemático para garantir o correto entendimento dos requisitos de topologia e elétricos.
- Realizar verificações físicas completas (DRC, LVS) e colaborar com extração de parasitas para simulações pós-layout (PEX).
- Avaliar impactos de variações de processo, ruído e acoplamento nos circuitos.
- Apoiar na definição de floorplan e integração de blocos analógicos em projetos mixed-signal.
- Otimizar o layout visando alta confiabilidade, robustez elétrica e rendimento fabril (yield).
- Documentar práticas de layout e participar ativamente das revisões de design.
- Colaborar com os times de design esquemático e design digital para discutir limitações e restrições para os circuitos por conta de sua implementação física.
- Colaborar com times de teste e caracterização na identificação de falhas relacionadas ao layout.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Identificar e propor soluções que atendam às demandas da parte elétrica das obras, através de levantamentos realizados juntos aos clientes, observando dados técnicos para que suas necessidades sejam atendidas de forma adequada.

  • Estudar o processo de montagem e manutenção mecânica, avaliando as condições operacionais, definindo as variações que podem ocorrer nos materiais, mão de obra e equipamentos, repassando para as devidas áreas.

  • Analisar os projetos elaborados pelos prestadores de serviços, avaliando dados e especificações técnicas, a fim de definir viabilidade de produção.
  • Subsidiar as áreas de Orçamento, Engenharia, Planejamento e Suprimentos, repassando informações vitais para elaboração de planejamentos, custos e materiais necessários no desenvolvimento da obra.
  • Dar suporte ao cliente, à área de compras e produção, interpretando os projetos a serem realizados, quando necessário ou solicitado.
  • Programar as etapas de trabalho para cada frente de trabalho, de forma a garantir o cumprimento do cronograma.
  • Ler, interpretar e discutir sobre plantas e projetos, objetivando o andamento da obra dentro dos padrões de tempo, recursos e qualidade desejadas.

description:
Operations & Logistics Sr Manager, Brazil

Join to apply for the Operations & Logistics Sr Manager, Brazil role at Zimmer Biomet

Operations & Logistics Sr Manager, Brazil

Join to apply for the Operations & Logistics Sr Manager, Brazil role at Zimmer Biomet

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talented team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels inspired, invested, cared for, valued, and have a strong sense of belonging.
What You Can Expect
As a senior member of the Brazil Commercial Operations team, this position is responsible for leading all aspects of the Commercial Operations function and its associated team in the country. The role holds full accountability for Demand Planning, Distribution, Customer Service, Inventory Management, and Operational Excellence in Brazil. Working in close partnership with the local Commercial leadership, this position is accountable for achieving functional goals related to customer service levels, forecast accuracy, inventory and asset performance, and for meeting cash flow objectives within the commercial P&L and related cost centers. In support of the Brazil Commercial Head and local business leaders, this role will also drive the use of Integrated Business Planning processes and tools to improve operational performance and cost efficiency, while aligning with the company’s global strategic priorities and transformation initiatives.
How You'll Create Impact

  • Leadership of the regional Supply Chain, Customer Service, Warehousing, Loaner Management and Distribution teams, ensuring SLAs and targets are met, KPIs are in place and all processes and centres are running at optimum efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Work closely with the Executive leadership to develop, propose and execute Customer Centric Supply Chain strategies that support the business and aim to provide competitive advantage in all areas of the Commercial Operations function.
  • Lead and grow Talent, including hiring, advancing, and retaining Talent within own region and in collaboration with the other Functions and HR. Own the regional Talent pool.
  • Own the execution of all Transformation related programs and projects in said area of responsibility as they relate to processes, people, footprint and technology.
  • Assure the delivery of correct Demand Plans that will enable the market to meet sales and service objectives. Own and execute all elements of the IBP process for the region.
  • Maintain high standards of Health & Safety across the region in accordance with the Company’s Health & Safety policy. Ensure departmental procedures support corporate quality & compliance requirements. Perform all activities in compliance with relevant Quality System standards.
  • Support and drive Product Life Cycle management & product rationalization execution to ensure smooth & well communicated market launch and exit of pre-defined product lines.
What Makes You Stand Out
  • Life Science and/or Medical Devices industry experience
  • Demonstrated & detailed level of knowledge and understanding of complex global Supply Chains.
  • Ability to operate independently and use judgment for high impact decisions.
  • Ability to simplify a complex supply chain, while considering global & regional tax implications
  • Demonstrated experience successfully leading and engaging teams across multiple locations within region.
  • Demonstrates effective written and oral communication and presentation skills, ability to interact with senior management.
  • Strong analytical skills, along with strong experience with analytics toolsets (Excel, Tableau)
  • Demonstrated Commercial Operations Strategy skills, with an ability to define and implement strategic initiatives
  • Understanding of strategic cost issues and uses range of techniques for cost reduction to meet targets.
  • Strong Financial acumen, with a solid understanding of Financial Statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash-Flows)
  • Ability to engage in contract negotiations and develop contracts on a national or regional basis; create basic project plans and manger source plan and implementation across functions and sites.
  • Comprehensive knowledge in job related functional area.
  • Conflict resolution, people development, delegation, and cultural sensitivity.
  • Strong background in process and change management.
Your Background
  • Excellent command of English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Over 10 years of relevant experience in similar operations roles, including proven leadership in operations management.
  • Preferably experienced in MedTech, ideally in orthopedics; however, backgrounds in other medical device areas (e.g., neuro) are also valued.
  • Strong financial acumen, with hands-on experience managing P&L, balance sheets, cash flow, and cost centers.
  • Proficiency with advanced supply chain systems and technologies (e.g., SAP, APO, or similar platforms).
Travel Expectations
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% to Rio de Janeiro, if not based locally.

title: Controller
description:
O Controller é um profissional estratégico no ambiente corporativo, com foco na gestão financeira, contábil e de controle interno. Ele desempenha um papel essencial no planejamento, monitoramento e análise do desempenho econômico da empresa, garantindo a precisão dos dados financeiros e a tomada de decisões fundamentadas.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  1. Planejamento e controle financeiro: Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento anual (budget) e previsões financeiras (forecast). Monitorar a execução orçamentária e propor ajustes para alinhar os resultados aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa. Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs).
  2. Gestão de contabilidade e demonstrações financeiras: Supervisionar a contabilidade geral (terceirizada), garantindo a conformidade com normas locais e internacionais. Revisar e validar demonstrações financeiras, como balanço patrimonial, demonstração de resultados e fluxo de caixa. Realizar análises financeiras para subsidiar relatórios gerenciais.
  3. Auditoria e compliance: Coordenar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo suporte e garantindo a transparência dos processos financeiros. Implementar e monitorar controles internos para mitigar riscos financeiros e operacionais.
  4. Gestão de custos: Monitorar e analisar custos operacionais para identificar oportunidades de redução e otimização. Implementar e acompanhar sistemas de controle de custos por produto, projeto ou unidade de negócio.
  5. Suporte estratégico e decisório: Atuar como parceiro estratégico da alta gestão, fornecendo análises e recomendações financeiras. Participar no desenvolvimento de estratégias de crescimento e alocação de recursos. Avaliar viabilidade de projetos e investimentos, considerando retorno financeiro e impacto no negócio.
  6. Liderança e gestão de equipes: Liderar equipes de contabilidade, controladoria e finanças, promovendo capacitação e desenvolvimento profissional. Garantir a integração das áreas financeiras com outros departamentos da organização.

Requisitos: Ciências contábeis completo. Desejável especialização em controladoria, auditoria ou áreas afins. Experiência em rotinas contábeis, financeiras e controladoria - tributação lucro real. Inglês será um diferencial.

Horário: Segunda a Sexta - 08h às 18h. Trabalho presencial em Goiânia - GO. Setor Santa Genoveva.

Contrato CLT + benefícios (VR R$24,00 por dia trabalhado + VA R$550,00 por mês). 50% do plano de saúde, convênio odontológico e seguro de vida em grupo.

  • Oferecer suporte aos aplicativos de operações no Brasil e contribuir com aprimoramentos/correções para melhorar a experiência do usuário, a eficiência do suporte e o processamento;

  • Desenvolver novos produtos usando plataformas locais/globais;
  • Melhorar a automação para permitir um ambiente de processamento mais direto;
  • Auxiliar as equipes internas usando conhecimento técnico e comercial quando necessário;
  • Propor soluções inovadoras de TI para garantir eficiência, eficácia e robustez.

Principais habilidades e requisitos

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em uma função de TI voltada para os negócios;
  • .NET - 3 anos de experiência trabalhando em um ambiente de produção, incluindo fornecimento e suporte a um produto de software;
  • ASP.NET Web Forms e MVC. Framework Dev Express;
  • Experiente em outras linguagens, como Java, Python e Scala;
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL, Sybase, Oracle, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com técnicas de ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), BPM (Business Process Management) e BI (Business Intelligence);
  • Exposição a Design Thinking, metodologias Lean e Agile;
  • Familiaridade com técnicas de ciência de dados (aprendizado de máquina);
  • Conhecimento de produtos de investimento (renda fixa, swap e derivativos; contratos de câmbio);
  • Ser prático e assumir a responsabilidade pelos problemas para garantir o acompanhamento;
  • Experiência em arquitetar e projetar fluxos de aplicativos de ponta a ponta. BPMN e Projeto de BluePrint de serviços;
  • Arquitetura orientada a serviços - experiência em trabalhar e desenvolver plataformas orientadas a serviços (projeto de arquitetura de microsserviços é um diferencial);
  • Fluência em inglês (escrita e falada);

Atuação híbrida - 3x no escritório.

description:

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.
We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes, and application clusters for customers across physical and public cloud estate, and we are raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a universal operator pattern and model-driven operations.
To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. You need to be interested in the scientific approach to operations at scale, driven by metrics and code, and you need to be able to learn the entire stack, from bare metal networking and kernel up to serverless and open source applications.
Location: Globally remote role
The role entails
Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.
To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.
As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure. We drive upgrades to keep our customers on the latest, best solutions.
What we are looking for in you

  • Degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science
  • Experience with Linux and familiarity with Linux networking and storage
  • Python software development expertise
  • Operational experience
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience with OpenStack or Kubernetes deployment or operations
  • Familiarity with public or private cloud management
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

É em razão disso, também, que procuramos desenvolver um espírito de time e de dono do negócio. Gostamos de compartilhar e comemorar cada conquista juntos e sempre buscamos promover novas possibilidades para que equipes e clientes SAP possam usufruir do que há de mais atual em termos de tecnologia. Queremos você que é apaixonado por inovação e pessoas.

O que te espera no dia a dia:

Um SAP Funcional SD é consultor com experiência (Sales and Distribution), que tem um conhecimento mais profundo dos processos de vendas e distribuição e já adquiriu experiência prática em projetos SAP. Esse profissional tem autonomia para realizar configurações complexas, solucionar problemas e colaborar diretamente com os stakeholders na implementação de soluções para os processos de negócio. Ele também desempenha um papel mais proativo no desenvolvimento de projetos e no suporte às operações de vendas e distribuição.

Esse profissional já está em uma posição de assumir maior responsabilidade em projetos e ajudar a liderar equipes menores, sendo um elo importante entre o negócio e a tecnologia.

Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial:

  • Configurações avançadas no módulo SD, incluindo customizações e ajustes para atender aos requisitos específicos de negócios, como cálculo de impostos complexos e integração de processos logísticos.

  • Resolução de problemas: é responsável por investigar e corrigir problemas de configuração e de processo, como falhas no faturamento ou inconsistências nos pedidos de vendas e entregas.
  • Liderança de partes específicas de projetos, atuando como ponto de referência para questões relacionadas ao SD e coordenando testes, implantações e suporte.
  • Execução de testes integrados e testes de usuário final (UAT – User Acceptance Testing) para garantir que as customizações atendam às necessidades do cliente e estejam integradas corretamente com outros módulos SAP.
  • Participação em rollouts e implementações de novos módulos SD em diferentes filiais ou regiões, ajustando configurações conforme os requisitos locais.

É diferencial:

  • Treinamento de usuários e criação de documentação de processos e configurações do módulo SD, servindo como referência para os usuários finais e a equipe de suporte.

description:
Good Shepherd Rehabilitation · Good Shepherd Specialty Hospital

Full Time (36+ hrs/wk), Night Shift - 12 hours, 7:00pm-7:30am

JOB SUMMARY

The respiratory therapist will perform specific duties and responsibilities as outlined. Under medical supervision, the individual must be able to adapt to the particular area of assignment and be able to perform accordingly.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. DELIVERS QUALITY CARE
    By integrating the elements of examination, evaluation, diagnosis, prognosis and intervention to optimize outcomes.
    By optimizing patient independence.
    By administering inhalants and aerosolized medications, performing bronchial hygiene, operating mechanical ventilators, delivering therapeutic gas administration, and by performing hyperinflation modalities per established respiratory protocols.
    Perform cardiopulmonary and hemological diagnostic studies.
  2. PROMOTES SAFE AND CLEAN WORKING ENVIRONMENT
    By complying with policies and procedures, rules and regulations governing environment of care and patient safety.
  3. DETERMINES AND/OR FACILITATES DISCHARGE/DISCONTINUATION OF SERVICES
    By analyzing achievement of anticipated goals and expected outcomes, planning discharge/discontinuation and providing appropriate home instruction, follow-up or referral.
  4. RECORDS PATIENT SERVICES
    By documenting, dating and authenticating respiratory therapy examination, evaluation, diagnosis, prognosis, intervention and outcomes in accordance with facility and regulatory guidelines.
    By billing for specific interventions provided.
  5. DEVELOPS AND ENHANCES PROFESSIONAL KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
    By participating in continuing education to maintain licensure, reviewing professional publications and providing learning experiences for professional development.
  6. CONTRIBUTES TO TEAM EFFORT
    By embracing change to achieve common goals, demonstrating willingness to provide service at other sites as necessary, investigating opportunities for new lines of services, contributing to the development of peers and promoting a positive work environment and by accomplishing related results as needed.
  7. COMPLIES WITH FEDERAL, STATE AND LOCAL LEGAL AND PROFESSIONAL REQUIREMENTS
    By understanding and adhering to current standards of practice for respiratory therapy, guide for professional conduct including the code of ethics and practice guidelines established by the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.
    By providing appropriate supervision to other healthcare professionals and coworkers.
  8. ENSURES OPERATION OF EQUIPMENT
    By completing preventive maintenance requirements, following manufacturer’s instructions, troubleshooting malfunctions, calling for repairs.
  9. PROTECTS PATIENT INFORMATION AND CONFIDENTIALITY
    By securing all information in confidential space, following facility confidentiality policy.
  10. CONTRIBUTES TO PI TEAM EFFORTS
    By assisting the Clinical Resource Specialist with data collection, monitoring, analyzing and reporting.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education
Associate's Degree in Respiratory Therapy required
Bachelor's Degree in Respiratory Therapy preferred

Work Experience
1-2 years of experience required
Clinical experience in all areas of respiratory care is preferred

Licenses / Certifications
Registered Respiratory Therapy license required
BLS/CPR for a healthcare provider, per the American Heart Association required

GOOD SHEPHERD'S UNIVERSAL FLU PROGRAM
As a health-care provider, we have a professional and ethical obligation to protect our patients and residents from developing further complications.
To protect our patients and residents, Good Shepherd requires influenza (flu) vaccinations for all Associates, licensed independent practitioners, contracted, agency and temporary employees, students and volunteers.

Important Note: Good Shepherd Penn Partners is a drug and tobacco free work environment. As a result, candidates selected for employment may be subject to a drug screen test. Good Shepherd Penn Partners does require the COVID vaccination for all employees.

description:
The Senior Compliance Counsel plays a key role in promoting Accenture’s compliance with confidentiality requirements, regulations and Accenture policies, with the goal of protecting the assets and reputation of Accenture.

The Senior Compliance Counsel supports the Managing Director – Competition Law with the implementation and management of Accenture’s Confidentiality Compliance Program and serves as a subject matter expert on confidentiality risk mitigation. This person helps the Legal team and the business understand confidentiality- and conflict of interest-related risks, compliance and program controls.

The Senior Compliance Counsel will coordinate with and leverage expertise from all teams within CORE, Global Contracting, Contract Management, other areas of Legal, and outside counsel, as necessary.

The Senior Compliance Counsel is expected to demonstrate leadership behaviors, which include adhering to Accenture’s Core Values (Best People, Stewardship, Integrity, Client Value Creation, Respect for the Individual, and One Global Network). He/she is also expected to promote and practice all aspects of Accenture’s leadership DNA (innovate for results, advocate an inspiring vision, collaborate across the ecosystem, execute with agility, and personalize in a truly human way).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

The role will focus on providing subject matter expertise and support to global business and corporate functions relating to confidentiality-related laws and regulations. It will particularly collaborate and provide legal guidance to various legal, security, and business teams regarding Accenture solutions, including addressing changes in the law that impact Accenture’s business.

The scope of work encompasses broad support to other parts of the Legal function, the Confidentiality Compliance Program and business stakeholders on:

  1. Transactional confidentiality-related matters in client contracts;
  2. Confidentiality-related reviews of the company’s services and offerings;
  3. Conflict of interest-related reviews of the company’s services and offerings.

This role will be responsible for developing and delivering relevant confidentiality-related trainings and communications, as well as tools, templates, resources and guidance materials.

Supports Accenture’s confidentiality program initiatives, including:

  1. Developing and delivering of confidentiality compliance and conflict of interest training;
  2. Developing, reviewing and implementing confidentiality and conflict of interest policies and internal controls;
  3. Planning and drafting confidentiality compliance communications with internal stakeholders;
  4. Working with senior management and outside counsel to conduct risk assessments, recommend improvements to the compliance program, and support the implementation of adopted recommendations;
  5. Working with internal stakeholders to build confidentiality compliance and monitoring tools to help Accenture executives flag, escalate and mitigate confidentiality and conflict of interest-related risks.

Provides objective, focused, practical advice and solutions to Accenture businesses and Legal Professionals regarding compliance with confidentiality-based laws and regulations, Accenture’s Code of Business Ethics, Accenture’s confidentiality policies, and all other related policies.

Collaborates with Legal colleagues and the business to identify, analyze and mitigate confidentiality- and conflict of interest-based risk.

Collaborates with Legal Ventures & Acquisitions colleagues and Corporate Development to identify, analyze and mitigate substantive confidentiality-based issues.

Collaborates with compliance colleagues to:

  1. Provide thought leadership for Accenture’s compliance efforts generally by staying abreast of compliance industry and conflict of interest best practices and changes in laws and regulations;
  2. Assist in the development of related policies to address business and legal requirements.

Responds to and helps manage internal audits and internal investigations related to confidentiality law issues.

RELATIONSHIPS:

Reports to: Managing Director – Competition Law

Relationships:

  1. Legal, including Contracting, Offerings, Alliances, Geographic Operations, Digital and Strategic Offerings, Contract Management, and Government Relations, as well as external counsel;
  2. Geographic leadership and key business leadership;
  3. Security consulting practice in the region;
  4. Legal V&A team;
  5. Related subject matter experts (e.g., security professionals, data privacy, and government compliance);
  6. Antitrust/Trade Secret professionals at client and peer companies.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education: JD or equivalent law degree (based on geography) required.

Work Experience: 7+ years of experience as an attorney focused on trade secret and antitrust law. Knowledge of conflict of interest laws is also helpful.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:

  1. Experience and demonstrated capability in creating and implementing global compliance programs for multinational companies, including preparing policies and internal controls; developing and conducting training; responding to government investigations; and drafting and reviewing contracts.
  2. Knowledge of Antitrust/Trade Secret/conflict of interest laws and regulatory systems around the world.
  3. Knowledge of compliance and ethics framework for global corporations.
  4. Must have the ability to work in a multi-cultural environment and work effectively remotely and within a global team.
  5. Ability to work independently and collaboratively across various levels.
  6. Ability to prioritize and make decisions, and a high level of common sense, including the ability to see around the corner and spot risks before they materialize.
  7. Good business acumen and knowledge of Accenture’s business strategy (or similar business strategy at another company if experienced hire).
  8. Ability to synthesize complex legal analysis into clear recommendations.

WORK REQUIREMENTS:

The ability to work with and manage resources remotely.

ADDITIONAL DESIRABLE CRITERIA:

  1. Good executive presence and the ability to work effectively with the senior business leaders at Accenture, senior Legal leadership and partner law firms.
  2. Builds and maintains a network of good working relationships both internally and externally.
  3. Adapts nimbly to changing needs within the business.
  4. Strong writing and negotiation skills.
  5. Fluent in English.

title: Programador(a)
description:
Quem somos?

A LEVTY é uma empresa de serviços em transformação digital corporativa. Nossos especialistas possuem alto nível técnico, sendo boa parte desse conhecimento formado e consolidado no dia a dia do trabalho.

Somos um dos principais parceiros estratégicos da SYDLE e atuamos fortemente com a plataforma SYDLE ONE, uma das mais utilizadas por grandes empresas para gestão de processos.

Além disso, temos um ambiente propício para o crescimento profissional, contando com um clima descontraído e flexível.

Ficou claro que pessoas são a alma do nosso negócio, não é?! Somos uma empresa jovem, com uma equipe altamente escalável e que cresce de forma sustentável.

O que é preciso para entrar no nosso time?

  • Paixão por tecnologia aliada ao potencial técnico! Para nós, essa combinação é um dos maiores diferenciais para fazer parte de uma equipe de alto desempenho.
  • Lógica de programação e flexibilidade em lidar com novas tecnologias. Temos abertura tanto para profissionais experientes como para os que estão no início da carreira.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharias ou afins são as que mais buscamos.

O que você fará em seu dia a dia?

Temos um dia a dia bem dinâmico. Não trabalhamos somente com desenvolvimento e codificação; os times são auto organizados e todos os membros têm oportunidade de participar de toda a esteira de construção de um Software, desde o levantamento e especificação de requisitos, definição de arquitetura, modelagem, implementação, testes, garantia de qualidade, até a implantação e manutenção de sistemas. Você poderá se desenvolver em várias áreas!

O trabalho é realizado em times colaborativos, totalmente focados em atingir os melhores resultados para cada cliente. Utilizamos metodologias ágeis e nossos Engenheiros e Engenheiras de Software possuem perfil full stack, trabalhando na plataforma SYDLE ONE.

As tecnologias utilizadas são: Javascript, Elasticsearch, React, API REST, entre outras.

Gostou da oportunidade? Entenda nossa seleção.

Ao cadastrar seu currículo, ele será analisado pelo nosso RH e, caso seja selecionado, entraremos em contato com você para informar sobre a nossa seleção - que ocorrerá em três etapas (Teste de Lógica, Bate-papo RH e Bate-papo Técnico). Portanto, verifique se seu contato no currículo está atualizado e confira sempre seu e-mail e telefone :)

Uma LEVTY para todos!

Entendemos que a inovação só nasce com a diversidade e sabemos da importância de cada um para a construção de um ambiente de trabalho autêntico e plural. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas, sem exceção, são abertas para todas as pessoas, e nossa seleção será adaptada de acordo com a necessidade de cada um!

Confira nossos benefícios!

Uma cesta de benefícios pensada para você!

Sabemos que pessoas diferentes possuem necessidades diferentes. Por isso, não há sentido em engessar nossos benefícios! Nos preocupamos em proporcionar um pacote com incentivos variados, para que cada colaborador usufrua da forma mais adequada à sua realidade!

Nossas opções:

  • Você pode escolher entre Bradesco e Unimed como plano de saúde e odontológico, além de poder incluir seu cônjuge e filhos.
  • Você também tem acesso a descontos exclusivos nos planos de saúde animal da Dog Life para cuidar do seu pet.
  • Nosso cartão de benefício é flexível; você não precisa escolher entre vale alimentação ou refeição, temos os dois em um lugar só - e ele não é suspendido nas férias.
  • Acesso ao "Total Pass": uma plataforma com descontos e acesso a academias e estúdios diversos.
  • Temos o vale-transporte para quem utiliza os ônibus urbanos, além de um benefício especial para quem adota o modelo híbrido/presencial.

description:
Senior Software Quality Engineer, AI Model Serving

Join to apply for the Senior Software Quality Engineer, AI Model Serving role at Red Hat

Job Summary

Are you ready to join a game-changing open-source AI platform that harnesses the power of hybrid cloud to drive innovation?

The Red Hat OpenShift AI (RHOAI) team is looking for a Software Engineer with Kubernetes and MLOps experience to join our rapidly growing engineering team. Our focus is to create a platform, partner ecosystem, and community to help enterprise customers solve problems and accelerate business success using AI. This is an exciting opportunity to build and impact next-generation hybrid cloud MLOps platforms, contribute to the RHOAI product, participate in open-source communities, and be at the forefront of AI evolution. You’ll join an ecosystem that fosters continuous learning, career growth, and professional development.

As a quality engineer for the Model Server and Metrics team in Red Hat OpenShift AI, you will actively participate in key AI components and open-source communities such as KServe, Kubeflow, and vLLM. You will work as part of an evolving team to design, develop, test, and release new capabilities. The role is primarily an individual contributor working closely with other engineers and cross-functional teams. A passion for open-source communities and developing integrated solutions with Red Hat, open-source, and partner technologies is essential.

What You Will Do

  • Lead contributions to architecture, design, and automation testing of new features for RHOAI, especially Model Serving capabilities
  • Participate in upstream MLOps communities to innovate in the domain
  • Ensure security, resiliency, and maintainability requirements are met
  • Develop integration and usability tests, collaborating with software engineers to ensure quality
  • Apply CI/CD best practices to deliver high-quality solutions into RHOAI
  • Share technical knowledge and promote continuous improvement within the team
  • Work with product management and cross-functional teams to clarify business needs
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders and team members about quality efforts
  • Conduct code reviews thoughtfully and promptly
  • Represent RHOAI at industry events, customer meetings, and open-source forums
  • Mentor and guide other quality engineers

What You Will Bring

  • Experience testing applications in Python; Go experience is a plus
  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes or OpenShift
  • Experience with CI/CD systems
  • Ability to quickly learn and guide others on new tools and technologies
  • Proficiency with source code management tools like Git
  • Passion for technology and innovation
  • Strong troubleshooting and system understanding skills
  • Autonomous work ethic, thriving in fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Practical experience over formal education in computer science or related fields
  • Experience in AI and MLOps, especially testing models served by MLOps platforms
  • Understanding of open-source communities
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS, GCE, Azure)

About Red Hat

Red Hat is a leading provider of enterprise open source software, delivering high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies worldwide. We promote a flexible, inclusive work environment and value innovative ideas from all team members.

Inclusion and Equal Opportunity

We are committed to diversity and inclusion, providing equal opportunity employment without regard to race, gender, or background. We support applicants with disabilities and provide accommodations as needed.

Job Description
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Embedded Linux Field Engineer for Devices/IoT to expand our reach in mission-critical industries such as Automotive, Medical Devices, Industrial Systems, Robotics, and Telco, as well as Consumer Electronics. We are looking for candidates who are accomplished Linux plumbers. If you are someone passionate about Linux, who knows the plumbing of the OS inside and out, who is proficient with containerization, system debugging, and the likes, then please keep on reading - this may be a uniquely exciting opportunity for you.
The server edition of Ubuntu is already very widely used in connected devices and industrial PC's. Our newer edition of Ubuntu for IoT, called Ubuntu Core, represents the state of the art in security and resilience for high end appliances and equipment. Our customers include global brands in consumer and industrial electronics as well as automotive and robotics. We continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. We recently added a real-time Linux capability and are working towards a range of certifications for these offerings. Together, this portfolio is Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity and footprint.
This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also dedicated team players that take pride in team and company wins.
We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.
What your day will look like

  • Engage customers during presales to gather requirements and explain our technology
  • Elaborate solutions to be proposed to prospective clients
  • Participate to the delivery of select projects related to Embedded Linux
  • Convey market requirements to key stakeholders in our organization, and sometimes participate to the development or refining of generic solutions to unlock market potential
  • Be both a customer advocate and a trusted advisor to Canonical
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Distribution / Packaging experience (deb, rpm, ...)
  • Solid embedded Linux experience (Yocto, Buildroot...)
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Professional written and spoken English in addition to the local language
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, ability to multi-task
  • A personal drive to meet commitments
  • An humble learner and quick study
  • Albeit many projects can be done remotely, the successful candidate will be willing to travel up to 30% of the time for customer meetings, company events, and conferences
  • For positions in Japan and Korea, the successful candidates will also be able to speak and write the local language at a professional level.
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with customer engagements a plus, but not a requirement
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Descrição

A visão de longo prazo da Amazon.com é proporcionar uma experiência de compra global consistente para todos os clientes, independentemente do site, dispositivo, idioma ou cultura. Nosso objetivo é desenvolver um software que ofereça uma experiência de compra única, alinhada às preferências de cada usuário. A equipe INTech Latam da Amazon está contratando desenvolvedores de software.

Sobre a posição

Um desenvolvedor de software (SDE) na Amazon resolve desafios de negócios através da tecnologia, é responsável por seus sistemas de ponta a ponta e influencia a direção tecnológica que impacta centenas de milhões de clientes ao redor do mundo. Espera-se que projete soluções escaláveis e flexíveis, trabalhando com estruturas de dados, algoritmos e programação orientada a objetos, enfrentando desafios complexos de computação em larga escala. Você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e de rápido crescimento, colaborando com profissionais de excelência.

Sobre você

Busca uma carreira onde possa construir, entregar e impressionar. Cria recursos que atingem milhões de clientes globalmente, analisa problemas de forma holística, projeta ciclos de feedback e contribui para ecossistemas diversos.

Local de trabalho

O time INTech Latam na Amazon trabalha no Centro de Desenvolvimento de Software no Brasil, criando recursos para o site da Amazon em diferentes países e apoiando operações. Você aprenderá a projetar, implementar e testar soluções escaláveis usando a plataforma AWS em projetos ágeis.

Valorizamos a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão

Na Amazon Brasil, temos um Comitê de DEI com representantes diversos, promovendo um ambiente interno plural. Nossos grupos de afinidade (BEN, , Glamazon, Pessoa com Deficiência) apoiam e representam diferentes comunidades, atuando como embaixadores da agenda de inclusão.

Requisitos básicos

  • Entender aplicações críticas ponta a ponta e avaliar designs de alto e baixo nível.
  • Contribuir na estratégia técnica das equipes, assumindo responsabilidades por trade-offs técnicos.
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem: C, C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, Kotlin, JavaScript, Clojure.
  • Experiência com design de sistemas, programação de aplicativos, banco de dados em UNIX/Linux.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Kanban, Scrum, etc.), modelagem OO, Web Services, UNIX e bancos de dados.

Qualificações preferenciais

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou área relacionada; mestrado é um diferencial.
  • Histórico com soluções de grande escala em ambientes ambíguos.
  • Conhecimento do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software e entrega eficiente.
  • Habilidades de relacionamento com clientes e entendimento profundo de requisitos.
  • Capacidade de propor soluções técnicas alternativas e liderar esforços de engenharia.
  • Experiência na entrega de projetos grandes e multifuncionais.
  • Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Habilidades analíticas e de design comprovadas.
  • Experiência em orientar e treinar equipes de engenharia em questões técnicas complexas.

A Amazon valoriza uma cultura inclusiva que promove resultados de excelência para nossos clientes. Se você possui alguma deficiência e precisa de adaptações durante o processo de candidatura ou contratação, acesse para mais informações.

title: Presales Design Support Architect - Service Management & Orchestration
description:
Orange Business is here!

About us

Orange Business is a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business. Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

About the role

The Presales Solution Design Support team being an integral part of the IPSE will interlock with Global Marketing, GDO, CDIO and International teams with a clear objective of streamlining the bid process, accelerate presales autonomy, simplify presales solution development and validation, and increase our win ratio. The team will continuously develop their skills in strategic domains as well as technical skills for the future to drive value to our customers. That’s why the 3 main strategy pillars for IPSE are based on;

  • Replicability through Capitalization: facilitate replicability using capitalization to optimize what has been already sold. Identify reusable solutions and ensure capitalization of repetitive proposed solutions to expand presales autonomy and support Product Management. More specifically, provide Brick and others documentation to accelerate sales autonomy
  • Improving Velocity of our solution design & validation, facilitate the Go to Market for more sales autonomy through early engagement by participating to qualification phase,
  • Bring add value expertise to the SVP, being aligned with the SVP strategy to support SVP and Innovative support integration

Job Description

The Presales Solution Design Architect will work within different squads as a pivotal link among all organizations and presales teams, committed to providing guidance, technical expertise and assistance to promote technically and commercially innovative solutions that matches customer needs.

He/She will guarantee simplified approaches leading to optimizations, facilitate new services integration and orchestration, increase the volume of available knowledge for replicability, and bring agility to the process.

Main activities

In their engagements the Presales Design Support Architect will navigate complexities and assist presales while;

  • Contributing actively to the international bid process providing support at different stages (consultancy via early engagement in qualification phase, guidance during design stage, validation and costing of non-standard elements, handover of won deals)
  • Being responsible for providing solution design expertise support to global presales teams with relevance to SVPs and domain of expertise.
  • Adopting new ways of working promoting agility and presales autonomy via replicability.
  • Engaging with Marketing and Business Development when appropriate to review strategy and solution positioning
  • Minimizing response times and ensure the quality of a solution in support of sales. Solutions are expected to be commercially competitive, while maintaining or exceeding the level of compliancy agreed within solution strategy.
  • Coordinating actions internally and externally to ensure all the solution components are implementable and operable from engineering, delivery (GDO & I2), operations, and IT standpoints.
  • Assessing associated risks of tailored solutions, providing recommendations for risks provisioning as feasible, and documenting those risks in internal risk register.
  • After the bid is signed, ensure a smooth transition of commitment and deliverables from Pre-Sales to Post-Sales and support pre-sales worldwide communities through active contribution

The Presales Design Support Architect will ensure high quality of the below deliverables;

  • Validation responses including High-Level-Design (HLD) describing how the solution can be built, and ensuring it’s interworking with existing technologies or other service blocks. The response shall be assigned a maturity level that indicates the level of autonomy for future reuse.
  • Current replicable solutions continuously enriched with design updates, new features, delivery experience and product position.
  • Jointly developed service definitions and product collaterals as part of engagements within squads and/or product team projects

The Presales Design Support Architect will keep up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies in relevant domains and provide recommendations for their adoption within orange business SVPs strategy

About you

Key Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

  • Customer, objectives and results driven
  • Solid technical skills and knowledge of relevant domain/ field of expertise inline with Evolution platform SVP (DI; Connectivity , Cloud , Security and Orchestration) .
  • Strong knowledge of Service Management and Service Integration solutions , ex: Observability , Service now .
  • Good knowledge of OB solutions, organization, tools and processes
  • Strong people networking, stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Experience in working with Sales, Product Managers or Factories (Engineering, Operations, Affiliates)
  • Knowledge of digital integration and API development to enable the integration of telecommunications infrastructure with other enterprise systems.
  • Autonomous and comfortable in unknown environments
  • Strong Synthetic skill
  • Leadership and matrix management
  • Changemaker by gathering knowledge and resources, proposals driver
  • Creative and innovative behavior
  • Influence, negotiation, and persuasion
  • Ability to work in a multi-cultural environment.

Qualifications, Education and Certifications

  • BSc degree in engineering or telecommunications science or equivalent
  • 10+ years of experience in telecommunications or IT industry
  • Vendor certifications in the relevant domain/ field of expertise inline with SVP.
  • High knowledge of agility and transformation management – Scrum, DevOps, SAFe certifications is a plus
  • English fluent (spoken, written)

Additional information

  • Global opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world
  • Flexible work environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working)
  • Professional development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities
  • Career growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange
  • Caring and daring culture: health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events
  • Reward programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards

Only your skills matter

Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

Enfermeiro(a) - Alemanha DEKRA - Expert Migration

Você é Bacharel em Enfermagem ou está no último semestre? Aproveite, essa pode ser sua oportunidade de ter uma carreira internacional.

O Expert Migration Brazil da DEKRA é um programa internacional que prepara enfermeiros para emigrar e trabalhar em hospitais, clínicas e lares para idosos na Alemanha. Junte-se aos mais de 3.500 enfermeiros que estão trabalhando na Alemanha e trilhe uma carreira de sucesso internacional.

COMO FUNCIONA O EXPERT MIGRATION BRAZIL
O Expert Migration Brazil oferece treinamentos a enfermeiros bacharelados para prepará-los ao reconhecimento da profissão na Alemanha.

DURANTE A PREPARAÇÃO VOCÊ CONTARÁ COM:
Com o Programa da DEKRA você conta com um treinamento no idioma alemão, a fim de obter a certificação de proficiência necessária para migração e trabalho na Alemanha. Neste treinamento você participa de aulas de alemão de 2ª a 6ª conduzidas por professores com formação na área de ensino de línguas estrangeiras e/ou experiência internacional, além de contar com atividades complementares, como aulas de reforço (plantão), treinamento para entrevistas e para certificação de idioma.

BENEFÍCIOS DO DEKRA EXPERT MIGRATION BRAZIL

Vantagens de participar:

  1. Oportunidades de carreira e crescimento profissional como enfermeiro na Alemanha;
  2. Trabalho em equipe com profissionais internacionais;
  3. Oportunidade de morar e trabalhar em um país com alto índice de qualidade de vida.

Benefícios oferecidos:
  1. Assistência no processo seletivo com empregadores alemães: preparação para entrevistas e elaboração de currículo;
  2. Possibilidade de contrato de trabalho como enfermeiro licenciado em organizações parceiras da DEKRA;
  3. Suporte na validação do diploma de enfermagem e emissão de licença profissional;
  4. Suporte no processo de emissão de visto para migração.

Requisitos para participar:
  1. Ser graduado ou estar cursando o último semestre de bacharel em Enfermagem (não é necessário experiência);
  2. Ter disponibilidade para participar das aulas de alemão;
  3. Possuir interesse em morar e trabalhar na Alemanha e vivenciar uma nova cultura;
  4. Ter até 42 anos no momento da candidatura.

Não é exigido ter o conhecimento de outros idiomas.


Aceitamos candidatura de todo o Brasil.
INSCREVA-SE AGORA! E não perca essa oportunidade.

Programa internacional, presente em 6 países, que prepara profissionais para emigrar e trabalhar na Alemanha de forma legal e segura. O Expert Migration prepara o profissional para exercer sua função de forma reconhecida na Alemanha.

Questrade Financial Group (QFG) of Companies is committed to helping our customers become much more financially successful and secure.

We are everything a traditional financial institution is not. At QFG, you will be constantly moving forward, bringing the future of fintech into existence. If you share the same sense of infinite possibility, come shape your future at Questrade.

We’re looking for our next Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Marketing Platform Engineering. Could It Be You?

Seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Marketing Platform Engineering to lead our Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) initiatives within the Marketing automation area. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in marketing technologies, extensive experience with Adobe Experience Platform, and a proven track record of leading engineering teams to deliver scalable and innovative solutions.

What’s it like working as a Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Marketing Platform Engineering at Questrade?

Reporting to the Director, Production & Operations, Engineering you will play a key role in translating Questrade’s direction for the overall systems aligning the technology roadmap within the Marketing technology domain. In partnership with the Director, identify significant architectural patterns and understand the impact on teams, advocate for strategic technology investments and roadmap alignment with the broader IT Strategy. Manage Engineering squads, including overseeing dependencies and long-term goals. Projects can be large and complex; this role is focused on setting the direction for the overall systems aligning the technology roadmap within the Marketing technology domain.

Adobe Experience Platform is the centralized and connected data foundation that powers customer experience management across Adobe Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, and Adobe Target. This role will involve the scaling out of the platform to multiple Lines of Business (Customer Journeys) making long term decisions that will guide the rollout.

Drive the strategic vision and implementation of AEP solutions to enhance our digital marketing capabilities.

Oversee the design, development, and deployment of AEP components.

Ensure seamless integration of AEP with other marketing technologies and data sources.

Manage multiple engineering projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including platforms, marketing, data science, and IT support, to gather requirements and define project scope.

Ensure project plans are maintained with status reports and documentation.

Stay current with industry trends and advancements in marketing automation.

Identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement within the engineering team.

Ensure the scalability, performance, and security of AEP implementations.

Strong in Data Engineering and System Integration.

Experience in Content Management Systems (CMS) would be advantageous.

Partner with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into technical solutions.

Communicate project progress, challenges, and successes to senior management and other stakeholders.

Act as a subject matter expert for AEP, providing insights and recommendations to drive business growth.

Champion the implementation of IT policies across multiple teams, influencing the department's overall compliance landscape.

Oversee the development and optimization of department-wide processes, ensuring they incorporate evolving IT/Cyber governance best practices.

Strategic partner with governance teams, advocating for necessary policy updates and contributing to risk assessments.

So are YOU our next Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Marketing Platform Engineering ? You are, if you have…

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

8+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.

Extensive experience with Adobe Experience Platform and its components (Adobe Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, and Adobe Target).

Proven track record of managing and delivering complex engineering projects in the digital marketing space.

Strong understanding of financial services and digital marketing trends.

Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with cloud platforms/capabilities such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Familiarity with data privacy regulations and compliance in the financial services industry. Certification in Adobe Experience Platform or related technologies.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.

Summary
Provides professional nursing care through skillful assessment, diagnosis, outcomes identification, planning, implementation, and evaluation in accordance with facility or department policies and procedures. Directs and manages the care of designated patients. Utilizes effective and appropriate communication styles. Assists in maintaining a safe work environment and maintains clinical and professional competency as appropriate to the population of patients served.

  • Assesses, plans, implements, and evaluates the care for designated patients. Recognizes the need for and initiates collaboration/communication with physicians, interdisciplinary team members, and takes actions to proactively resolve patients needs.

Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

  11. Controle do sistema de captura de projetos elegíveis ao benefício de inovação tecnológica – Lei do Bem.

description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Software at TRACTIAN

The software department at TRACTIAN is at the forefront of innovation, crafting an integrated ecosystem that revolutionizes maintenance and process management. Comprising a dynamic team of experts, the department develops an all-in-one software solution that seamlessly combines predictive maintenance capabilities with a comprehensive Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). This visionary approach empowers maintenance and process teams with a unified platform, enabling them to proactively predict equipment failures, optimize maintenance workflows, and enhance operational efficiency. In daily work, the software department drives the convergence of cutting-edge technology and maintenance excellence to propel businesses toward unparalleled success.

What you'll do

As a Staff Frontend Software Engineer , your role will focus on the development and enhancement of key features for our Web applications. You will be responsible for creating and refining features that are both user-centric and effective.

Responsibilities

  • Work with engineers & technical leaders across the company to ship products on strong foundations.
  • Build high-quality end-to-end product experiences for platforms and improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes.
  • Develop and lead the team to execute against both short-term and long-term roadmaps.

  • Identify, scope, and lead large technical projects, laying the groundwork for early-stage products to iteratively evolve and scale, and taming complexity and shoring up reliability of existing systems.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in front-end development, with a minimum of 3 years dedicated to React.
  • Deep understanding of React principles and patterns, including but not limited to compound, presentational, and HOC patterns.
  • Experience in implementing caching strategies or asynchronous state management for high data load applications.
  • Strong knowledge in web performance optimization and cross-platform compatibility.
  • Experience working across engineering teams and other functions in building alignment, driving decision making, and communicating transparently. Experience mentoring and helping in the development of engineers and peers.

Bonus points

  • Track record of leading frontend platform development in a high-growth tech environment.
  • Experience in creating offline applications or desktop applications using Electron/Tauri.
  • Experience in high-volume data processing.
  • Fluent in English.
